mapper.select: SELECT s.ID, s.SOURCE_ID, s.COLLECTION_NAME, s.DIMENSION, s.DISTANCE_METRIC, s.METADATA_SCHEMA, s.INSTANCE_KEY, s.MODEL_KEY, s.BIZ_KEY, s.CREATE_TIME, s.UPDATE_TIME, s.CREATE_USER, s.UPDATE_USER, s.ENV_CODE, src.NAME AS SOURCE_NAME, src.EXTENSION_CODE AS SOURCE_PROVIDER, inst.INSTANCE_NAME FROM AI_VEC_STORE s LEFT JOIN AI_VEC_SOURCE src ON s.SOURCE_ID = src.ID AND src.DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN AI_INSTANCE inst ON s.INSTANCE_KEY = inst.INSTANCE_KEY AND inst.DELETED = 0 WHERE s.ID = #{id} AND s.DELETED = 0

SELECT s.ID AS STORE_ID, COUNT(DISTINCT d.ID) AS DOC_COUNT, COUNT(seg.ID) AS SEGMENT_COUNT, COALESCE(SUM(seg.WORD_COUNT), 0) AS TOTAL_WORD_COUNT, MAX(COALESCE(seg.UPDATE_TIME, seg.CREATE_TIME, d.UPDATE_TIME, d.CREATE_TIME)) AS LAST_SYNC_TIME FROM AI_VEC_STORE s LEFT JOIN AI_VEC_DOC d ON d.COLLECTION_ID = s.ID AND d.DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN AI_VEC_SEGMENT seg ON seg.DOC_ID = d.ID AND seg.DELETED = 0 WHERE s.ID = #{storeId} AND s.DELETED = 0 GROUP BY s.ID
